title: Six-fingered diorite hand found at Shuruppak

tellings.quote: they actually found this really weird diorite hand diorite is one of the hardest stones on Earth that has six fingers

plain: At Shuruppak, an ancient Sumerian city in what is now Iraq, digging in 1931 is said to have found a hand carved from diorite, one of the hardest stones on Earth, with six fingers. The researcher Matt LaCroix tells this, crediting the excavation report of the Penn Museum, the University of Pennsylvania's museum, which dug the site. If true, it would raise the question of why ancient carvers showed a six-fingered hand in such hard stone.
